# Collection acceptance, bill finance and original delivery

Scope: `actual_collections`. All amounts are integer minor units. A buyer acceptance notice is not a cash receipt. Each physical bill has its own face, prior actual receipts, acceptance result and title. An earlier-period advice cannot establish current acceptance. At the acceptance event the bank records the buyer's actual total accepted amount; published possibilities include historical receipts, not an additional amount.

## Receivables and finance

A bill may be discounted once after actual acceptance. Any positive integer amount up to accepted less received and previously assigned receivables is eligible. The bank pays that principal less the bill's fixed discount charge and acquires that amount of the unpaid bill. This sale cannot be cancelled and its fee is not refundable. Incoming buyer payments first discharge that bill's assigned outstanding rights; only the remainder credits the customer's cash. A payment against one bill cannot discharge another bill's assigned rights. Historical receipts were already included in cash and are never credited again.

The first payment event brings the recorded early amount for each bill. The last payment event pays the remainder of the actual accepted amount. At each event the bank posts the gross buyer payment, assigned-right reduction and actual customer cash credit separately. An unsupported or unaccepted balance is not a scheduled payment. Existing bank cash does not include these future receipts.

## Original documents

Accepted goods are represented by whole units at the recorded unit price. On a DA collection, title may be released after acceptance for at most the accepted units. A DP collection requires actual cumulative buyer receipts for each released unit. A discount advance is a financing receipt, not buyer payment for DP title. The bank mechanically dispatches an owner's signed whole-unit instruction from original custody, including an early instruction; the agent is responsible for the collection terms and quantity. Dispatch is irreversible. Documents for rejected units must be returned to the exporter; acceptance amounts settle this scope. Returning documents for accepted goods cannot be undone through this service. The original total covers the face amount divided by unit price.

## Service instructions

Unlock `propose_actual_collection`; pass `case_id`, `action`, `data`. Each instruction needs an owner approval bound to the exact parameters.

| Action | Data | Effect |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `discount` | `bill_id`, `amount_minor` | Sell currently unpaid accepted rights and credit principal less the one-time bill fee |
| `pay` | `payable_id`, `amount_minor` | Debit bank cash and pay the registered invoice; any positive available amount is accepted |
| `deliver` | `bill_id`, `quantity_units` | Send the indicated original documents to the buyer |
| `return_documents` | `bill_id`, `quantity_units` | Return the indicated original documents to the exporter |

The bank prevents insufficient cash and duplicate physical document movements; it does not select the customer's financing optimum, preserve a private cash floor, or reconcile invoice overpayment. Queries and failed attempts do not move logical time. `wait_for_update` advances to the next scheduled result. A deadline is inclusive. Documents and payments must actually complete by the business deadlines.

## Standardized exact service interfaces

The following exact interfaces belong to this business service. Unlocking one returns the executable JSON Schema. Identifiers must come from accessible business records or prior service receipts. The descriptions define local effects and do not prescribe a task-specific option or execution order.

### `propose_actual_collection`

Prepare a bill-finance sale, registered payable payment or original collection-document movement.

| Field | Type | Required | Public source and meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `case_id` | string | yes | Obtain the exact identifier from the applicable business record or a prior service receipt; do not ask the customer to invent an internal ID. |
| `action` | string | yes | Use the value established by the applicable business record, customer fact, or prior service receipt. |
| `data` | object | yes | Use the value established by the applicable business record, customer fact, or prior service receipt. |

Read only: `false`. Customer approval required before execution: `true`.
